comment: Native-dependency pins consumed by `blade setup`/`blade doctor` (docs/plan-toolchain-packaging.md). Versions live HERE, not in scripts or docs. The Blade-REPL repo has a sibling deps.json for its vendored plotting packages.

dependencies.name: openblas
dependencies.note: Default BLAS/LAPACK, pinned to the same version as the known-good prebuilt (C:\Users\cdupu\tools\OpenBLAS-0.3.34-x64). `blade setup --blas=source` shallow-clones this tag and runs `make && make install PREFIX=...` (needs make + gfortran; NO_LAPACK=1 without gfortran). Prebuilt installs are configured via OPENBLAS_DIR or the explicit BLADE_BLAS_* tier instead.

dependencies.name: netcdf-c
dependencies.note: Recommended via package manager (MSYS2 pacman mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-netcdf / apt libnetcdf-dev / brew netcdf); NETCDF_DIR points at a custom prefix. No pinned version: the C API surface Blade uses is stable.

dependencies.name: mpi
dependencies.note: MS-MPI runtime + MSYS2 msmpi import lib on Windows; OpenMPI or MPICH elsewhere. Link spelling owned by Platforms.mpiLinkFlag.

dependencies.name: cuda
dependencies.note: Optional. nvcc on PATH; on Windows nvcc drives cl.exe (VS Build Tools, vcvars64).
